kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: From cybersecurity to AI to Taiwan, what's at stake in Trump's summit with Xi
wire.summary: As President Trump and China's President Xi prepare to meet, Rush Doshi of the Council on Foreign Relations explains the current state of U.S.-China relations and what to expect from this summit.

wire.title: It's getting harder to afford rent in the U.S., even for middle-income families
wire.summary: Housing affordability challenges are spreading to higher income brackets, according to new research, which found one in five renters struggled last year to pay for their housing in full and on time.

wire.title: Greetings from Edinburgh, where a cheeky tour guide makes art history hilarious
wire.summary: For anyone who grew up staring blankly at museum artwork, this is the fun that was missing: Coco leads interactive and (mostly) factual art history comedy tours.

wire.title: Is Nepal's flood a harbinger of what's to come in the Himalayas?
wire.summary: Building dams and hydropower plants in the Himalayas holds great promise for providing electricity. In the wake of the Nepal disaster, experts are asking about the risks of such construction.

wire.title: Dems have an edge over GOP, poll finds. And, ICE looks into 'mobile detention centers'
wire.summary: An NPR poll shows that Democrats have an edge over Republicans going into the midterms, partially due to Trump. And, Immigration and Customs Enforcement is looking into "mobile detention centers."

wire.title: U.N. Ambassador Mike Waltz on Iran, Venezuela and Trump's foreign policy
wire.summary: Deals, threats and oil are all on the table as the president's foreign policy takes center stage.

wire.title: Will FDA advisers recommend a multi-cancer blood test for approval? They'll vote
wire.summary: The company Grail says its Galleri blood test can detect up to 50 forms of cancer. An independent panel of experts will decide if the test should be recommended for FDA approval.

wire.title: DOJ defends White House media ban, urges court to reject lawsuit
wire.summary: The Department of Justice defended President Trump's recent media ban, arguing that reporting by CNN, MS Now and Politico on a wide range of issues jeopardized national security and spread falsehoods.

wire.title: Major news outlets banned by Trump will have their day in court
wire.summary: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are asking a federal judge to hold the president in check for what they say is a violation of their Constitutional rights simply because he doesn't like how they cover him.

wire.title: As Congress confronts AI, Senate lawmakers are shut off from its most advanced tools
wire.summary: While Senate offices have access to chatbots like ChatGPT, they are not authorized to use any of the more advanced tools that are at the center of regulatory talks and public debate about AI safety.

wire.title: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
wire.summary: Masoud Pezeshkian's defiant speech to the UN comes after the US president threatened to "annihilate" Iran if a peace deal is not agreed soon.

wire.title: Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war
wire.summary: The local authorities reportedly seize Tigray's airports following reports of recent drone strikes.

wire.title: White House rolling out red carpet for historic Xi Jinping visit
wire.summary: Trump and Xi are expected to discuss a range of issues from trade to AI during the latter's multi-day visit to Washington.

wire.title: Dramatic eviction of woman aged 87 highlights Spain's housing shortage
wire.summary: The tenant of the flat in Madrid, Maricarmen, was unable to pay the rent set by the firm which recently bought it.

wire.title: Dolly Parton's manager accuses her nephew of 'threats and intimidation'
wire.summary: Bryan Seaver, who announced Parton's death to the world, is accused of trying to extort her estate.

wire.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in prison for sexual assault
wire.summary: In court, Miriam Haley said the assault had a "devastating effect on my life and sense of security that may never go away".
